budget.calibration_accounting: Shared ledger: development consumes the same allocation. Full 240x3 test worst-case needs all2880 calls. Separately authorized prior budget amendment or revised sample/precision is required if calibration uses it.

human_gate: Requires actual independent benchmark/semantic judgments, source/protocol/data freeze, explicit human resource authorization and bound real verification evidence. Software cannot authenticate reviewer identity or grant authorization.

lean.verification_policy: src/verify.py exact-type harness, no proof escapes/new axioms; generated imports/commands additionally prohibited

primary_endpoint: Strict fixed-type first-repair verification among known initial failures; incomplete comparisons remain unknown

statistics.missingness: Known initial failures remain in bounds even if repair comparison invalid. Unknown initial eligibility reported separately; never recode missing as false.
statistics.multiplicity: Two simultaneous nominal97.5% percentile CIs by Bonferroni; descriptive95% also reported; no new p-values
statistics.resampling: Whole theorem clusters with all available seeds; row-weighted unequal-family sensitivity
statistics.sample_precision: 240 independent theorem means: worst-case normal-approximation95% half-width12.7pp; no guaranteed power. Reassess actual independent count before freeze.

stopping: Stop on first newly unavailable generation/verifier infrastructure outcome, allocation/runtime exhaustion or nonconforming backend; checkpoint and complete-grid unknown export retained. Explicit resume skips consumed unknown calls without replay and may attempt only remaining samples. Nonconforming backend remains blocked. No efficacy-based stopping.
study: New isolated first-repair C/D/E experiment; not historical replay

token_matching.donor: Frozen hashed ranking, first eligible initial-failure diagnostic from another ID/family, excluding prohibited pairs and byte-identical payloads; assignment sealed before any repair
token_matching.policy: Preserve all structured error message data/kind/positions; exact rendered4096 tokens using deterministic neutral suffix search; invalidate comparison if full payload cannot fit or exact matching is unreachable
token_matching.wrapper: Same single-user chat template for all arms
